utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, Noah’s still getting the repair drive details straight, but as soon as he sends me the plan, I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — just make sure everyone knows it’s now Sunday at the community center, and yes, we’re still collecting tools in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll tell everyone it’s Sunday at the community center, and that we’re still collecting tools while Noah finishes the plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, let’s wait for Opal to confirm the exact spot first, then we’ll match the checklist to what Oren’s already bringing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, that makes sense—I just want the parking and drop-off plan nailed down before I commit to bringing anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s the right order, Pia—once Opal confirms the exact spot, we’ll set the parking and drop-off plan first and then decide what you should bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there early to get things started, and even a short while from folks helps more than you’d think.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear—I’ve only caught second-hand updates, but it sounds like extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and maybe folding tables are still the main needs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that’s about it—if you can bring any of those by, it’ll make the morning go a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m setting the list this afternoon with my toolbox and fold-up table on it, and then I’ll send it to Ira once the spot’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm who’s actually using the side street and whether the driveway’s definitely staying clear once the spot is confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can’t confirm that part yet—I’m waiting on Opal to lock the spot, but once she does I’ll check the side street and make sure the driveway’s staying clear before I send Ira the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Once the item list’s set, send it over and I’ll handle pickups this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know. Cleo said the fence patch and tool sorting still need help, so I’d start there once she sends the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Works for me. Have Cleo send the list as soon as it’s ready, and I’ll take care of pickups this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Ira, from what I’m hearing they’re still pulling things together—tools and tables are the main gaps, and we still need someone to lead the roof work.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—once Oren sends that list this afternoon, I’ll coordinate with Leo while I’m out so pickups for the tools and table stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, thanks—I’ve got Faye penciled in for sorting or phone outreach after drop-off, so if Oren’s list changes anything, just loop me in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around 9 with my ladder and toolbox, and we can start on the gutters first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot, but the porch steps and the center’s leaky roof are still our top priorities, and we still need someone to take lead on the roof work.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it—I can still be there around 9 with my ladder and toolbox, and I’m happy to help on the roof if that’s where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mina, Mara’s taking the tool sorting, so I’m focused on getting the fence patching covered while we keep the porch steps and center roof as top priorities.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, who exactly is covering the center roof, and are we assigning Gus there or to a one-story gutter job?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We haven’t assigned the center roof yet, Mina, so I’d keep Gus on the one-story gutter job and leave the roof for someone better set up for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tess, I’m still confirming the exact spot, but the flyer points to the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good to know—that matches what I’d heard, and I’m still telling folks the big asks are extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and folding tables.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess—I’m checking the flyer to confirm whether it’s exactly at the community center parking lot, and I’ll pass that along once I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I’m still sorting the repair drive details out, but I’ll send the plan over as soon as I’ve got it straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good—once you’ve got it sorted, send it over, and I’ll keep inviting folks and mention we still need extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and folding tables.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah—thanks, Quinn. I’m still getting the plan straight, but send me what you’ve got on those supplies and I’ll follow up once the details are settled.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m just waiting on Opal to confirm the spot, then I’ll send Leo one short finalized item list right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—once Opal confirms, send me anything that needs sorting or calls, and I can handle it after drop-off and before 2.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye—I’ll send you whatever still needs sorting or calls as soon as Opal confirms the spot and I’ve sent Leo the final list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll be a little late, but when I get there I can start by sorting the tools for a while.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—that helps. Before I place anyone, can you confirm whether we’ve got a lead for the center’s roof yet, or if there’s actually a one-story gutter job at 9 for Gus?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still coming in late, and I haven’t heard firm details yet—Vik said Noah’s sorting the plan and will pass it along once it’s set.
